clauses.quote: Educational aides and school assistants, who are assigned to the school, shall be scheduled to assist teachers with cafeteria and playground duty.
clauses.notes: Passive construction places scheduling duty on management; benefits workers by ensuring aide support for duties.

clauses.quote: Teachers will not be required to fill out any forms unless they are official DCPS forms or forms required by a government agency or forms devised jointly by SCAC and the Administration.
clauses.notes: Negated obligation functions as a relief from duty, granting teachers a right to avoid non-mandatory paperwork.

clauses.quote: Adequate facilities and supplies will be made available in Teacher washrooms.
clauses.notes: Passive voice implies a management duty to provide adequate facilities.

clauses.quote: Dispensers for female needs shall be made available in an appropriate location in the school.
clauses.notes: Passive voice implies a management duty to provide hygiene supplies.
